record.decision: library-parity-audit.html, compositions-to-build.md and old-kit-deprecation-audit.html are retired. design-system-schema.json is the only register. Do not consult the audits for counts; scan for the number with composition-scan.js.
record.movedTo: C:/Code/tebra-catalog/audits/archive/, with a README.md stating the reason and listing the known errors.
record.whyRetired: Wrong three times, each time with something downstream inheriting the error: Menu recorded as having no properties when it has 8; <Table> recorded as 15 files when 15 is the TableContainer count and <Table> is 21; Autocomplete recorded as 58 files when it is 88. A fourth figure from the same generation — MuiRadioButton affecting 52 files — is also wrong; verified 38.
record.rootCause: Line-based grep. It misses a call site whose props begin on the next line, and misses TSX generic call sites entirely. composition-scan.js reads balanced braces and resolves import source per file, which is why its counts and the audits diverge.

notMoved.status: Superseded by gap-list-sorted.md by that document own opening statement, but NOT named in the retirement decision, so left in place. Flagged in the archive README as a candidate.
